c1-15-01.title: Communicative Challenge: When the Model Fails
c1-15-01.scenario: Károly asks when a machine learning model does not work well.
cues: Say that the model works well
c1-15-01.target: A modell jól működik, kivéve, ha az új adatok nagyon mások.
c1-15-01.english: The model works well, unless the new data are very different.
c1-15-01.canDo: I can state an exception about a model with *kivéve, ha*.

c1-15-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Very Large Model
c1-15-02.scenario: Károly asks why training a large language model takes so long.
c1-15-02.prompt: Give the background, then say the result.
c1-15-02.target: Figyelembe véve a modell méretét, a tanítás nagyon hosszú.
c1-15-02.english: Taking the size of the model into account, the training is very long.
c1-15-02.canDo: I can add a background to a sentence with a participle (*figyelembe véve, eltekintve*).

c1-15-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Network Nobody Understands
c1-15-03.scenario: Károly asks why a big neural network is hard to understand.
c1-15-03.prompt: Explain it with a pair of connected phrases.
cues: Say how big the network is
c1-15-03.target: Minél nagyobb a hálózat, annál nehezebb megérteni a döntéseit.
c1-15-03.english: The bigger the network, the harder it is to understand its decisions.
c1-15-03.canDo: I can say how two things grow together with *minél … annál*.

c1-15-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Old Data
c1-15-04.scenario: Károly asks where an algorithm in a scoring system gets its knowledge from.
c1-15-04.prompt: Say what you think, with a probability adverb.
cues: Name the source of its knowledge
Show that you are not completely sure
c1-15-04.target: Az algoritmus vélhetően a korábbi adatokból tanul.
c1-15-04.english: The algorithm presumably learns from earlier data.
c1-15-04.canDo: I can say how likely something is about an algorithm (*vélhetően, feltehetőleg, minden bizonnyal*).

c1-15-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Brain and the Machine
c1-15-05.scenario: You have read the text about Neumann János. Károly asks what it says about the brain.
c1-15-05.prompt: Tell Károly what the text says about the brain.
cues: Say whether the brain is fast or slow
Say what the brain does at the same time
c1-15-05.target: Az agy és a gép különbözik, mégpedig a sebességben.
c1-15-05.english: The brain and the machine differ, namely in speed.
c1-15-05.canDo: I can explain a point with *mégpedig* or *nevezetesen*.

c1-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Know About AI
c1-15-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you to sum up what you have learned about models.
c1-15-consolidation.prompt: Say when a model works and what makes it hard to understand.
cues: Say how size and understanding are linked
c1-15-consolidation.target: A modell jól tanul, kivéve, ha az adatok mások; minél nagyobb, annál nehezebb megérteni.
c1-15-consolidation.english: The model learns well unless the data are different; the bigger it is, the harder it is to understand.
c1-15-consolidation.canDo: I can state an exception and a background about a model.
